featured_reviews.name: Pawan Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear All,

I hope this message finds you well.

I’m writing to share a critical and personal experience regarding Money2me that I believe every potential or current customer should be aware of. Please read this carefully, especially if you're considering engaging with this bank for any services – particularly gold loans.

1. Unauthorized Auction Notice Sent to Incorrect Address
My first and most alarming experience was when I was informed that my gold was about to be auctioned. Shocked, I asked the bank why I had never received any official notice. They claimed to have sent it to an address in Virar — a location I’ve never lived in or provided. In fact, my actual residence is in Kandivali, and the bank had verified this during my KYC process by visiting my home and collecting my utility bill.

The situation escalated to the point where the matter had to be taken to the police. Thankfully, with the intervention of law enforcement, I was able to prevent the wrongful auction of my gold. This incident left me deeply concerned about the bank’s recordkeeping and ethics.

2. Unreasonable Interest Policy and Lack of Transparency
If you're planning to pledge your gold with this bank, be very cautious about their interest rate policies. If you fail to pay the interest by the 30th of the month, they drastically increase your slab. This makes it extremely difficult to recover your gold unless you have a strong and steady source of income. There is no leniency or clear communication — only harsh penalties that put your valuables at serious risk.

3. Highly Unprofessional Release Procedure
Perhaps the most frustrating part of my experience is related to the release process. On a Saturday, I called one of their representatives to request the bank account details needed to make the final payment for releasing my gold — nearly ₹12 lakhs. As per their policy, the gold is to be returned within 24 hours of payment. I urgently needed the gold for a family function scheduled on Tuesday.

Despite multiple follow-ups, I still haven’t received the necessary details. I’ve made repeated calls to customer service — at times calling 3 to 4 times just to get one response. Each time, I’m told the account details have been escalated to the Head of Department (HOD) at their Mira Road branch (where my gold is pledged), and that they’re “waiting for a response.”

At this point, I feel completely helpless. I have no option left but to share my experience publicly so that others don’t go through the same ordeal.

I’m also attaching relevant proof to support every claim made here.

Final Word of Caution:

If you’re a new customer or thinking of becoming one, I strongly advise you to reconsider. This bank does not operate with customer transparency, efficiency, or empathy. The lack of accountability and basic professionalism is deeply disappointing.

Please feel free to reach out if you want further clarification or assistance with your own dealings.
